patch.summary: Replace a private-location check's authentication (secret references only, full replace)
patch.description: Request headers and URL credentials as ${SECRET:NAME} reference templates. The private location resolves each name on its own machine; a credential's value is never sent to or stored by RealUptime. `{}` removes all authentication. See docs/api.md "PATCH /checks/:id/auth".

400.description:

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO-8601 start of the range (inclusive). Clamped to the account's retention window.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO-8601 end of the range (exclusive). Clamped to now.

parameters.name: check_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated check ids. Omitted means every check the account owns.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Only results from this probe region.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Downsample interval (e.g. 30s, 5m, 1h, 1d). Omitted returns raw rows.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Row cap for this response (default 1000, max 5000).

get.summary: Current monitor state as a Prometheus/OpenMetrics scrape target

200.description: Prometheus text exposition (Content-Type: text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8) of every check's current up/down state, latency, status code, last-checked time, and consecutive failure count per region, plus one open-incident gauge per check. Current state only, cached briefly per account.

post.summary: Flag planned work on one monitor agent's server: no incident, no alert, no downtime
post.description: Accepts an account API key with read-write access to monitors, or the agent's own token with id set to the agent's id or to self. While the window is active the agent's offline and server-health alerts are withheld, and every check that runs from the agent, or whose target host is in hosts or is the host name the agent reports, opens no incident, sends nothing, and does not count against uptime. When the window ends, evaluation resumes from that moment: anything still down is reported then, never backdated. Posting while a window is active extends it to now plus minutes and adds the new hosts.
